title: BIAS BP4/PP3 predictor-aggregation defect: specify, measure, choose wrapper vs upstream (no AGPL edit)

revision.finding: MAJOR: removed the false claim that pathogenic_classifiers.py L405-433 is a get_pp3/phyloP-window helper or a direct correct-idiom proof. L405-433 is get_pm1 (a DIFFERENT criterion's domain max-aggregation), cited only as corroboration. Defecthood is now grounded PRIMARILY in get_pp3 L944-954 / get_bp4 L491-503 own code+comments (dead best_score sentinel, permanently-false BP4 `best_score>1` guard, `>=`-loop last-tool resolution vs 'best score'/'same max score' comments and downstream tie/consensus logic).

defect_anchors.pp3: pathogenic_classifiers.py::get_pp3 L944-954 (best_score=0 never reassigned; score=last tool; +1 on any >=2 tools)
defect_anchors.bp4: benign_classifiers.py::get_bp4 L491-503 (best_score=0 never reassigned; score=last tool; consensus bump never fires because best_score>1 always false)
defect_anchors.correct_idiom_reference: pathogenic_classifiers.py::get_pm1 L405-433 (if score > best_score: best_score = score) is a DIFFERENT criterion's generic domain max-aggregation idiom — corroborating context only that BIAS authors knew the correct pattern; it is NOT a get_pp3/phyloP-window helper and NOT proof by itself
defect_anchors.defecthood_grounding: proven inside get_pp3 L944-954 / get_bp4 L491-503 themselves: best_score sentinel init 0 and never reassigned (dead); get_bp4 consensus guard `best_score>1` permanently false (BP4 never bumps); `>=` loop with no reassignment yields the last tool not the max — contradicting the blocks' own 'best score'/'same max score' comments and downstream tie/consensus logic
defect_anchors.constants: constants.py score_to_hum_readable L13-, pp3_tools/pp3_weighting L159-160, bp4_tools/bp4_weighting L63-64

correction_route_decision.primary_expected: RAPTOR-side arm's-length wrapper (recompute corrected strength from observable rationale) when Probe 3 shows undecidable==0
correction_route_decision.fallback: propose upstream PR to bitscopic/BIAS-2015 for any undecidable class; adoption gated on separate re-pin + full re-score + re-validation (out of scope here)
correction_route_decision.constraint: never edit the vendored AGPL source; never import bias_2015; pinned BIAS commit stays byte-unchanged (ADR-0007)

tester.responsibility: Author AC tests (AC-A1..AC-A7) from slot 2 + slot-1 surfaces only, before the doer. Author the intended-aggregation synthetic oracle (Probe 1) independently; never import bias_2015.

doer.responsibility: Build the config + wrapper + probe to pass the ACs, in sequence predictor-aggregation-spec -> wrapper -> probe. May add tests, never weaken; honor slot 3.

checker.responsibility: Re-verify all ACs; run Probe 2/3 over census + held-out TSVs; confirm no AGPL edit / no bias_2015 import / pin byte-unchanged; confirm emitted strength stays visible and no clinical classification is produced.

blockers: Requires the committed 6,618-VUS census BIAS output TSV and the 2,577-record held-out TSV to run Probes 2/3 (materiality + decidability). Absent them, only the synthetic oracle (Probe 1) runs and the route decision cannot be finalized.
